Forwards page to JSP engine
Translates page to servlet
Compile page into servlet
Compile servlet into bytecode
What are differences between MVC1 and MVC2?
They differ in the way the controller is organized
They differ in the scale of the application
MVC1 is page-centric where as MVC2 is controller-centric
They differ in the complexity of the application

Expression
Declaration

getString("columnName")
getString(1)
getString(index)

It accesses the name property of the user object
It is a scriptlet

In custom tag development, how does the BodyTag interface differ from the SimpleTag interface?
BodyTag is used for tags without body content, while SimpleTag is for tags with body content.
BodyTag provides more control over the tag's body content processing than SimpleTag.
SimpleTag is the newer, more complex interface, while BodyTag is outdated.
BodyTag is not used in custom tag development, whereas SimpleTag is the standard.
What are common errors of JDBC connection to a database? (Choose 3 answers)
JDBC driver not found
Database URL is not recognized by JDBC driver
Unauthorized user on DBMS
URL statement is invalid or wrong syntax
What are tasks for define a custom JSP tag
Create the Tag handler class
Create the Tag Library Descriptor (TLD) file and define tags.
Create the JSP file that uses the Custom tag defined in the TLD file
Create the JSP file that uses the JSTL tag
What is the correct way to use an external JSP page using JSTL?
<c:import url="header.jsp"/>
<c:include file="header.jsp"/>
<c:forward page="header.jsp"/>
<c:redirect url="header.jsp"/>
Giải thích: JSTL dùng thẻ <c:import> để import/include tài nguyên bên ngoài.
What is the correct sequence of the servlet life cycle methods?
init(), destroy(), service()
service(), init(), destroy()
init(), service(), destroy()
destroy(), init(), service()
Giải thích: Vòng đời Servlet: khởi tạo init(), xử lý request service(), cuối cùng hủy destroy().
What annotation can be used to declare a Servlet Filter in Java 3.0 and later?
@WebServlet
@WebFilter
@FilterMapping
@ServletFilter
Giải thích: Từ Java Servlet 3.0 trở lên dùng annotation @WebFilter để khai báo Filter.
Which EL operator is used to perform a null-safe navigation, avoiding NullPointerExceptions?
?? là null-coalescing
Which EL operator would you use to concatenate strings in JSP?
copy
Giải thích: Trong EL/JSP có thể dùng toán tử + để nối chuỗi.
Which HTTP method is primarily used for creating a new resource?
POST
GET
DELETE
PATCH
Giải thích: HTTP method POST thường được dùng để tạo mới resource trên server.
What syntax is used to denote an EL expression in a JSP page?
Giải thích: EL (Expression Language) trong JSP được viết dưới dạng ${expression}.
What file is commonly used for packaging a Java web application, including servlets and JSP files?
.zip
.jar
.war
.ear
Giải thích: File .war (Web Application Archive) dùng để đóng gói ứng dụng web Java gồm Servlet, JSP, cấu hình, thư viện,...
What method is used to store an attribute in the ServletContext object?
setContextAttribute()
addAttribute()
setAttribute()
addContextAttribute()
Giải thích: ServletContext dùng method setAttribute() để lưu attribute.
Which EL operator is used to access properties or attributes of objects? Hoàng Hoàng
. (dot)
+ (plus)
* (asterisk)
: (colon)
Giải thích: EL dùng toán tử dấu chấm . để truy cập thuộc tính/object property.
Which symbol represents placeholders in a SQL query within a PreparedStatement?
Giải thích: Trong PreparedStatement, dấu ? được dùng làm placeholder cho tham số SQL.
Which package provides the JDBC API in Java?
java.sql
javax.jdbc
org.jdbc
com.db.jdbc
Giải thích: JDBC API nằm trong package java.sql.

In Java web applications, which of the following URL patterns is commonly used in a <servlet-mapping> to indicate that a servlet should handle requests for all URLs in a specific directory and its subdirectories?
/servlet/*
.html
/pages/
Giải thích: Pattern /servlet/* dùng để map tất cả URL trong thư mục /servlet/ và các sub-path của nó.
For generating an HTML page in JSP, which content type must be set using the page directive?
text/xml
text/plain
text/html
application/json
Giải thích: JSP tạo trang HTML nên content type thường là text/html.
Which descriptor file is used to map the custom tag to its tag handler class?
web.xml
index.html
taglib.tld
deployment.descriptor
Giải thích: File .tld (Tag Library Descriptor) dùng để khai báo và map custom tag với tag handler class.
In a standard Java web application, where is the deployment descriptor (web.xml) typically located?
/WEB-INF
/META-INF
/WEB-INF/classes
Root directory
File deployment descriptor web.xml nằm trong thư mục /WEB-INF.
Which directory is used to store external libraries (JAR files) in a Java web application?
/WEB-INF/lib
/WEB-INF/classes
/META-INF
Root directory
Các file thư viện .jar của Java web app được đặt trong /WEB-INF/lib.
Which of the following files is used to define custom tags in a JSP application?
.html files
.jsp files
.tag files
.java files
Custom tags trong JSP có thể được định nghĩa bằng .tag files.
Which input type is used for uploading files in an HTML form?
type="file"
type="upload"
type="text"
type="input"
HTML dùng input type="file" để upload file.
Which attribute marks a JSP page as an error page?
isErrorPage="true"
errorPage="true"
error="true"
isError="true"
Trong JSP page directive, thuộc tính isErrorPage="true" dùng để đánh dấu trang xử lý lỗi.
What is the lifecycle method called when a Servlet is being initialized?
init()
start()
begin()
initialize()
Khi Servlet được khởi tạo, container sẽ gọi method init() đầu tiên.
What is the first method called when a filter is initialized in a web application?
initFilter()
initialize()
init()
setupFilter()
Filter trong Java web application cũng dùng method init() để khởi tạo.
Which JDBC method return a ResultSet?
execute()
executeQuery()
executeUpdate()
updateQuery()
executeQuery() dùng để thực thi câu lệnh SELECT và trả về ResultSet.
What's the purpose of the close method when handling JDBC resources?
resultSet.close(); statement.close(); connection.close();
connection.release(); statement.release(); resultSet.release();
connection.end(); statement.end(); resultSet.end();
resultSet.close(); statement.end(); connection.close();
JDBC resources được đóng bằng method close() để giải phóng tài nguyên.
Which method is called when a servlet is being removed from service?
destroy()
stop()
end()
dispose()
Khi Servlet bị gỡ khỏi service/container sẽ gọi method destroy().
Which method is invoked most during servlet operation?
init()
service()
destroy()
doGet()
doPost()
service() là method được gọi nhiều nhất để xử lý các request gửi tới Servlet.
Which method of the javax.servlet.Servlet interface is responsible for handling client requests and generating responses during the servlet life cycle in a Java web application?
init()
service()
doGet()
destroy()
Method service() trong interface Servlet chịu trách nhiệm xử lý request từ client và tạo response.
Which method is called by a filter to intercept an incoming HTTP request?
doFilter()
init()
service()
filterRequest()
Filter dùng method doFilter() để chặn và xử lý HTTP request/response.
Which method retrieves the current session or creates a new one if none exists?
request.newSession(true)
request.getSession(true)
request.getHttpSession()
sessionManager.get()
getSession(true) sẽ lấy session hiện tại hoặc tạo mới nếu chưa tồn tại.
Which lifecycle method is invoked when a Simple Tag Handler is first initialized?
doTag()
init()
processTag()
doStartTag()
Which method in the Simple Tag Handler class is responsible for processing the tag?
doStartTag()
doEndTag()
doTag()
doPost()
doTag() là method thể hiện xử lý nội dung của Simple Tag Handler.
Which method of the ServletContextListener interface is called when the ServletContext is initialized?
contextInitialized()
contextCreated()
initContext()
initializeContext()
contextInitialized() được gọi khi ServletContext được khởi tạo.
Which method is used to handle POST requests in a servlet?
doPost()
doGet()
processRequest()
handlePost()
doPost() xử lý các HTTP POST request trong Servlet.
Which of the following is the correct order of servlet life cycle phase methods?
init(), service(), destroy()
initialize(), service(), destroy()
init(), execute(), destroy()
init(), service(), delete()
Vòng đời Servlet: khởi tạo init() → xử lý request service() → hủy destroy().
When using JDBC, which method helps to get the number of records affected after performing UPDATE or DELETE?
stmt.getAffectedRows()
stmt.countRows()
stmt.getRowCount()
stmt.executeUpdate()
executeUpdate() trả về số dòng bị ảnh hưởng bởi lệnh UPDATE/DELETE/INSERT.
During which method call are the JSP's form data and cookies available?
jspInit()
_jspService()
jspDestroy()
jspDoStart()
Form data và cookies khả dụng khi JSP đang xử lý request trong _jspService().
In an HttpServlet, what method is responsible for processing both GET and POST requests?
doGet()
doPost()
service()
processRequest()
Trong HttpServlet, method service() tiếp nhận request rồi phân phối đến doGet() hoặc doPost().
In a Java web application, which of the following statements is used to execute an SQL query against a database?
executeUpdate()
executeQuery()
executeStatement()
executeSQL()
executeQuery() dùng để thực thi câu lệnh SELECT và trả về ResultSet.
In a JSP, how do you use a custom tag defined in a tag library descriptor (TLD) file?
<jsp:useTag>
<jsp:include>
<%@ taglib %>
<myCustomTag:tagName>
Khai báo tag library trong JSP bằng <%@ taglib uri="..." prefix="..." %>; sau đó dùng custom tag với cú pháp <prefix:tagName>.
Which tag is used to declare a variable or method in JSP?
<var>
<declare>
<scriptlet>
Which JSTL core tag is used for iterating over a collection in Java Servlet?
<c:set>
<c:forEach>
<c:choose>
<c:if>
<c:forEach> dùng để lặp qua collection hoặc array trong JSTL.
Which JSTL core tag is used to conditionally render content based on a boolean expression?
<c:if>
<c:choose>
<c:when>
<c:otherwise>
<c:if> dùng để render nội dung theo điều kiện boolean.
Which JSTL core tag is used to output a value onto the JSP page?
<c:out>
<c:display>
<c:print>
<c:value>
<c:out> dùng để xuất giá trị ra JSP page.
Which JSTL tag is used to loop over a collection of objects?
<c:forEach>
<c:iterate>
<c:loop>
<c:repeat>
Giải thích: JSTL dùng <c:forEach> để lặp qua danh sách object.
Which syntax is correct for JSP Scriptlets?
<%=code%>
<%--code%>
<%code%>
<!code>
Which HTML element is used to create a form in a Java web application?
<form>
<input>
<from>
<section>
Giải thích: Thẻ HTML tạo form là <form>.
Which of the following elements in the web.xml deployment descriptor is used to map a servlet to a URL pattern in a Java web application?
<servlet-name>
<servlet-class>
<url-pattern>
<mapping>
Giải thích: <url-pattern> dùng để map servlet với URL pattern trong web.xml.
Which of the following code snippets is a correct example of a JSP scriptlet?
<jsp: int i = 0; i++; %>
Giải thích: Đây là cú pháp chuẩn của JSP scriptlet.

Which of the following represents the XML equivalent of this statement <%@ include file="connect.jsp"%>
Select the one correct statement Hoang Hoang
<jsp:include file="connect.jsp"/>
<jsp:include page="connect.jsp"/>
<jsp:directive.include file="connect.jsp"/>
There is no XML equivalent of include directive.
Which method of the FilterConfig object is used to access initialization parameters in a filter?
getInitParameter()
getConfigParameter()
getParameter()
getFilterParameter()
Which XML elements are used to define a servlet filter in the web.xml file?
<filter> and <filter-mapping>
<filter-definition> and <filter-mapping>
<filter> and <application-filter>
<servlet-filter> and <filter-mapping>
Which JSTL tag is used to set the locale for formatting and parsing in a JSP page?
<fmt:setLocale>
<fmt:setTimeZone>
<fmt:formatDate>
<fmt:message>
Which JSTL tag is used to format dates and times according to the user's locale?
<fmt:setTimeZone>
<fmt:setLocale>
<fmt:formatDate>
<fmt:setBundle>
Which JSTL tag is used to format numbers according to the default user's locale?
<fmt:parseNumber>
<fmt:setNumber>
<fmt:formatNumber>
<fmt:setLocale>
Which directive must be used in a JSP page to include another resource at request time?
<jsp:include>
<jsp:plugin>
<jsp:useBean>
<jsp:setProperty>
Which XML element is used to specify initialization parameters for a servlet in the web.xml file?
<param>
<init-param>
<configuration>
<servlet-param>
Which JSTL tag is used to check if a variable or attribute is null or empty?
<c:if test="${empty myVar}">
<c:when test="${myVar == null}">
<c:check value="${myVar}">
<c:validate test="${empty myVar}">

Which of the following JSTL usages correctly generates the URL
https://fpt.edu.vn/student?code=SE123456

How do you access a request parameter named "user" via EL?
${param.user}
${requestScope.user}
${sessionScope.user}
${applicationScope.user}
${request.user}
${request.param.user}
How are <fmt:parseDate> and fmt:formatDate different?
<fmt:parseDate> turns a date into text, and fmt:formatDate turns text into a date
<fmt:parseDate> turns text into a date, and fmt:formatDate turns a date into text.
They do the same thing
<fmt:parseDate> is for calculations, and fmt:formatDate is for showing dates.
A bean present in the page and identified as ‘mybean’ has a property named ‘name’. Which of the following is correct way to print the value of this property?
<%out.println(mybean.getName())%>
<%=out.println(mybean.getName())%>
<jsp:getProperty name="mybean" property="name"/>
<%= jsp.getProperty name ="mybean" property="name"%>
In a JSP scriptlet, what is the correct syntax for declaring an integer variable named "count" and initializing it to 10?
<% int count = 10; %>
<% var count = 10; %>
<% int count = 10 %>
What is the difference between< jsp:include> and jsp:forward?
<jsp:include> includes content at runtime; jsp:forward stops page execution
<jsp:forward> includes another resource; jsp:include forwards the request
Both tags perform the same function
None of the others
What is the correct syntax for accessing the first element of a collection named "items" in EL?
${items[0]}
${items.get(0)}
${items.first()}
${items[1]}
Giải thích: EL dùng index bắt đầu từ 0 để truy cập phần tử đầu tiên của collection/list.
What is the correct syntax for accessing the first element of a List named "myList" in EL?
${myList[0]}
${myList.getFirst()}
${myList.first}
${myList.getFirst}
Giải thích: Trong EL, truy cập phần tử List bằng cú pháp [index].
What syntax does EL use to access an element in a list?
${list(index)}
${list.get(index)}
${list[index]}
${list.element(index)}
Giải thích: EL truy cập phần tử trong list/array bằng toán tử [].
What is the correct syntax for accessing the length of a String stored in a request attribute named "message" using EL?
${message.length}
${requestScope.message.size}
${message.length()}
${fn:length(message)}
Giải thích: JSTL function fn:length() dùng để lấy độ dài của String hoặc collection trong EL.
Which EL expression is used to access elements of a collection by index?
${collection[index]}
${collection.get(index)}
${collection.element(index)}
${collection[getIndex()]}
Which of the following EL expressions correctly accesses the "name" property of a JavaBean named "user" stored in the session scope?
${sessionScope.user.name}
${user.name}
${session.user.name}
${requestScope.user.name}
How would you use EL to access a property named title from a Map object within a List named bookList at index 2?
${bookList[2].title}
${bookList.get(2).title}
${bookList["2"].title}
${bookList.title[2]}
How is the deployment descriptor of a web application typically named?
application.xml
web.xml
config.xml
server.xml
How can a servlet send a redirect to the client?
response.sendRedirect("url");
request.sendRedirect("url");
redirect("url");
forward("url");
Given a bean product with a Map<String, Integer> stockPerStore, how to access the stock of key "store101"?
${product.stockPerStore["store101"]}
${product.stockPerStore.store101}
${product.stockPerStore.get("store101")}
${product.stockPerStore["store101"].value}
In EL, assuming employeeNames is a list in Java, how can you check if it contains the name "John"?
${"John" in employeeNames}
${employeeNames contains("John")}
${employeeNames.indexOf("John") ne -1}
${fn:contains(employeeNames, "John")}
What is the correct code to set the time out for a session to 30 minutes in Java Servlets?
session.setMaxInactiveInterval(30 * 60);
session.setInactiveInterval(1800);
session.setTimeout(30 * 60);
setSessionTimeout(session, 30);
None of the other
Giải thích: setMaxInactiveInterval() nhận đơn vị giây, nên 30 phút = 1800 giây.
Which URI is correct for accessing the JSTL core library?
http://java.sun.com/jsp/jstl/core
http://java.servlet/jstl
http://java.sun.com/jsp/core
http://java.net/core
Giải thích: Đây là URI chuẩn của JSTL core tag library.
How to store a value in ServletContext from a Servlet?
context.setAttribute("key", value);
request.setAttribute("key", value);
session.setAttribute("key", value);
response.setAttribute("key", value);
Giải thích: ServletContext dùng setAttribute() để lưu dữ liệu application scope.
Which structure of Status Line in Response Message is
[HTTP Version] [Response Code] [Status]
[HTTP Method] [Protocol Version] [Requested Resource forming URI]
[HTTP Version] [Response Code] [Http Method]
[HTTP Version] [Protocol Code] [Http Method]
Giải thích: Cấu trúc status line của HTTP Response là: HTTP-Version + Status-Code + Reason-Phrase.
Consider the HTML code below. Which of the following method calls can retrieve the "userName" value sent from the browser? (Choose one)
getFormValue("userName") of HttpServletRequest
getField("userName") of HttpServletRequest
getParameter("userName") of ServletRequest
getParameters("userName") of HttpServlet
Giải thích: Dữ liệu form gửi từ browser được lấy bằng request.getParameter("userName").
What method is used to execute a SQL query and obtain the result set?
int result = statement.executeUpdate("SELECT * FROM table_name");
ResultSet resultSet = statement.execute("SELECT * FROM table_name");
ResultSet resultSet = statement.executeQuery("SELECT * FROM table_name");
boolean result = statement.execute("SELECT * FROM table_name");
Giải thích: executeQuery() dùng để thực thi câu lệnh SELECT và trả về ResultSet.
How can a Simple Tag Handler access the body content of the custom tag?
By using the 'getWriter()' method of the 'JspWriter' class.
By implementing the BodyTag interface in the tag handler class.
By using the 'getJspContext().getOut()' method of the 'JspContext' class.
By using the 'getParent()' method of the 'javax.servlet.jsp.tagext.Tag' interface.
Với Simple Tag (SimpleTagSupport), để xử lý body content, thường làm như sau: getJspBody().invoke(getJspContext().getOut());
How can you define a servlet mapping without using web.xml?
By using annotations like @WebServlet(urlPatterns = "/example") in the servlet.
By configuring servlet mapping in a separate properties file.
By defining servlet mappings in the servlet class using the setMapping() method.
Servlet mapping without web.xml is not supported.
None of the others
Giải thích: Từ Servlet 3.0 có thể dùng annotation thay cho web.xml.
What is the method signature for an event where an attribute was removed from an HttpSession?
public void attributeDeleted(HttpSessionBindingEvent event)
public void removeAttribute(HttpSessionBindingEvent event)
public void attributeRemoved(HttpSessionBindingEvent event)
public void sessionInvalidated(HttpSessionEvent event)
How can you include another JSP file within a JSP page?
Using the <import> tag.
Using the <%@ include > directive.
Using the <link> tag.
Using the <external> tag.
Giải thích: JSP include directive dùng để nhúng file JSP khác vào trang hiện tại.
How can custom tags be declared in a JSP file?
Using the <jsp:taglib> directive.
Using the <jsp:include> directive.
Using the <jsp:attribute> directive.
Using the <jsp:useBean> directive.
Giải thích: Custom tags được khai báo trong JSP bằng directive <%@ taglib ... %>.
In a JSP error page, how can you access the exception object thrown by the server?
Using the <error> tag
Using the exception implicit object
Using the error implicit object
Using the <exception> tag
Giải thích: Trong JSP error page (isErrorPage="true"), object exception được dùng để truy cập exception phát sinh.
If a session attribute named "cart" stores a List of items, how can you access the second item in the list using EL?
${cart.get(1)}
${cart[1]}
${cart(1)}
${cart.item(1)}
Giải thích: Trong EL/JSTL, List có thể truy cập phần tử bằng cú pháp index trong []. Phần tử thứ hai có index là 1.
How can you create a drop-down list in an HTML form?
Using the <dropdown> element
Using the <list> element
Using the <select> element
Using the <options> element
Giải thích: Thẻ <select> dùng để tạo danh sách xổ xuống (drop-down list) trong HTML. Các lựa chọn bên trong dùng thẻ <option>.
In JSTL, how can you test if a variable is defined or not?
Using the <c:exists> tag.
Using the <c:if> tag with a condition checking for null.
Using the <c:isNull> tag.
Using the <c:defined> tag.
Giải thích: JSTL không có thẻ <c:exists> hay <c:defined>. Thông thường dùng <c:if test="${var != null}"> để kiểm tra biến có tồn tại hay không.
How does a servlet obtain client data sent in an HTTP request?
Using the getParameter() method of HttpServletRequest.
Using the getParameter() method of HttpServletResponse.
Using the getAttribute() method of HttpServletRequest.
Using the getAttribute() method of HttpServletResponse.
Giải thích: Trong Servlet, dữ liệu client gửi lên qua request được lấy bằng request.getParameter("name").
How do you retrieve the value of a session attribute named 'userRole' in Java Servlets?
String role = session.getAttribute("userRole");
String role = session.retrieveAttribute("userRole");
String role = request.getParameter("userRole");
String role = getAttribute("userRole");

Giải thích: Session attribute được lấy bằng phương thức getAttribute() của đối tượng HttpSession. Thực tế thường cần ép kiểu:

String role = (String) session.getAttribute("userRole");
Which of the following is a correct syntax of the method that is used to get the initialized parameter in ServletContext or ServletConfig?
String getInitializedParameter(String name)
String getInitParameter(String name)
String getContextParameter(String name)
String getBoolParameter(String name)
Giải thích: ServletConfig và ServletContext dùng phương thức getInitParameter() để lấy tham số khởi tạo trong web.xml.
What is the correct code to perform URL rewriting by appending a parameter named 'sessionID' with value '123' to the current URL in a Java Servlet?
String url = response.appendParameterToURL("sessionID", "123");
String url = request.appendURLParameter("sessionID", "123");
response.sendRedirect("currentURL?sessionID=123");
